input.family_summary: High risk. The message demands $500 in gift cards today and says to keep it between us. Gift cards as payment, a same-day deadline and a request for secrecy are classic scam signs, and the FTC says only scammers ask for payment in gift cards. No money has been sent. Please call the person who received this and do not buy any cards.
input.elder_message: This looks like a scam, so please do not buy any gift cards or send anything. It is always okay to stop and talk to your family before you do anything.
call_questions: Who contacted you, and how did they say they know you? Did they ask you to keep it secret or to hurry?
Have you bought any gift cards or shared any card numbers, codes or personal details yet? If so, we can call the card company right away.
